nodes.description: Both DYNC1I2 alleles are disrupted: a canonical splice-donor variant (homozygous), a nonsense variant, a deletion of the whole gene, or the missense variant p.Tyr247Cys, which zebrafish complementation shows to attenuate gene function similarly to the nonsense allele. Structural modeling places Tyr247 on the linker between the N-terminal dimerization helix and the WD40 scaffold domain that couples the dynein heavy chain and light roadblock chain. The c.607+1G>A splice variant has not been tested on patient RNA. The molecular functions bound here (dynein heavy chain binding and dynein light chain binding) come from DYNC1I2's GO phylogenetic (IBA) annotations, and intermediate-chain subunit binding has not been measured directly for any patient allele.
